_comment: Reviewed duplicate merges. Every entry was checked against both records' content before being added: same species, same plant part or preparation, and no unique clinical claim that would be lost. `carry_note` is a sentence from the duplicate that the canonical record was missing.

merges.carry_note: The red ecotype is also the one studied for prostate health and bone density in male populations.
Withania somnifera var. afghana grows wild in Afghanistan and Pakistan and is used in Unani medicine as a rejuvenating adaptogen.
Valeriana officinalis var. bohemica is the Central European variety used in Czech and Slovak folk medicine for sleep, anxiety and nervous conditions.
The Kashmiri variety (Crocus sativus var. cashmirianus) grown around Pampore is used in Unani medicine for mood, cognition and inflammatory conditions.
Cynarin and luteolin in the leaf extract stimulate bile production, which is the mechanism behind its choleretic use.
The whole plant, stalk and leaf, is used in Thai, Malaysian and Caribbean medicine for fever, digestion and antimicrobial purposes.
Astragalus membranaceus var. koreanus is the Korean variety used in Hanbang medicine as a qi and immune tonic.
Coffea liberica var. dewevrei is the rarer Excelsa variety, with a distinct flavour and the same caffeine and antioxidant profile.
Fenugreek widely cultivated in Turkey used in Ottoman medicine for digestive, metabolic, and hormonal conditions.
Dried form of ginger used in TCM — more warming and less dispersing than fresh ginger (Sheng Jiang); specifically for cold in the middle burner.
Larger-fruited Korean variety of Chinese hawthorn cultivated and used medicinally in Korean Hanbang medicine for digestion and cardiovascular health.
Black seed widely used in Indian Unani and folk medicine as immune tonic, respiratory herb, and metabolic support.
Premium Kashmiri-grown saffron used in Ayurveda for skin, mood, and reproductive health.
Pungent thyme variety from North African coastal areas used in Libyan folk medicine for respiratory and digestive conditions.
Most common and widely studied maca variety, used for energy and general hormonal balance.
Whole seed form of black seed used as a condiment and complete medicine in Prophetic and folk medicine.
Turmeric variety grown in Okinawa used in local folk medicine for liver support and longevity.
Persian variety of fenugreek central to Unani and Persian medicine for blood sugar, digestion, and male health.
Calendula variety cultivated in Poland used extensively in European folk medicine for skin, anti-inflammatory, and wound healing.
Major TCM herb that releases the muscle layer, raises yang and body fluids, treats fever and stiff neck, and reduces alcohol cravings. Now studied extensively for alcohol use disorder.
Cracked Reishi mushroom spores with highest concentration of ganoderic acids for potency.
Fresh or differently processed schisandra berries used in specific TCM preparations for different clinical applications.
Juniper widespread across Balkans and Southeastern Europe used for urinary, digestive, and antimicrobial conditions.
Black pepper variety native to Sri Lanka used in Siddha medicine as a bioavailability enhancer and digestive tonic.
A calming sedative herb used in Tibetan medicine for sleep disorders and nervous conditions.
Turmeric variety grown throughout Polynesia used in Tongan traditional medicine for anti-inflammatory and digestive conditions.
Native passionflower from South American highlands used for anxiety, insomnia, and nervous conditions.
